# Cue: Teleprompter

> Cue is a teleprompter for Android phones: write or import a script, keep the words near the camera and record takes without a watermark. Optional Voice Pace scrolls while you talk and waits when you pause. Free download with unlimited scripts and watermark-free recording. Cue Plus is a one-time A$2.99 for Voice Pace, Voice Follow and extras.
